name: V V Food & Beverage Co.,Ltd
summary: V V Food & Beverage Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of soymilk powder, animal, plant protein beverages, dairy products, tea, and other products in China and internationally. It offers cereal flakes, liquid soybean milk, lotus root powder, flour, and animal and plant protein beverages. The company also engages in the grain procurement, acquisition, warehousing, soft drinks, grains and oil, flour, sales, and processing activities; provision of investment services; livestock breeding; and liquor trading platforms.
